notes: 1. Buyer KYC URL is https://uat.xrportal.in/kyc?unitId=<base64> (Buyer host uat.xrportal.in — NOT uat-web). Auth is Mobile-OTP only; UAT mobile 8888888888 / OTP 147258; the JWT lives in sessionStorage. Direct /kyc with no unitId param shows an EMPTY_GATE (no headings, no form, no applicants table) — the flow only renders when reached from the 'Complete KYC' button (Home Dashboard / Allotment) which passes ?unitId=<base64> (visual-memory buyer/kyc INDEX.md, re-verified 2026-06-06).

2. KYC is post-WINNER only: it is accessible only after the unit booking payment is confirmed (RegistrationUnit.status = WINNER) and KYC is not already submitted (isKycSubmitted = false). A booked-but-not-paid buyer has no KYC access (BRD §4 rule 8, WF §3, FS 1.3).

3. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] = a disposable UAT record/state/document must be supplied before executing this test. Buyer KYC WRITES documents/PII/co-applicant records to the live UAT booking — every submit / upload / add-applicant / approve / e-verify TC is destructive and is marked [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] + carries a user-authorisation requirement. Do NOT invent PII / PAN / Aadhaar / DOB / photographs / document scans. Use only disposable UAT data the user supplies.

4. MUTATION-AUTHORISATION: per CLAUDE.md pipeline rule 7, no live-portal mutation (upload, add applicant, submit KYC, tick-and-confirm, e-verify) may be executed on a UAT booking without explicit user authorisation — UAT accounts are stateful and KYC submission is one-way (it sets isKycSubmitted=true, generates the payment schedule and marks the Mavis booking Final). Capture-only steps (open drawer, view summary, read labels) are safe.
5. [VERIFY WITH DEV] = behaviour not confirmed in BRD/FRD/FS/Workflow; confirm before treating Pass/Fail as authoritative. [To verify] tags the specific open question.

6. KYC GLOSSARY: 'Complete KYC' = the orange alert/button on the Home Dashboard booking row that opens /kyc?unitId=. 'Verify Details' = the per-applicant link on the Step-1 Add Applicants table that opens the Add Applicant drawer. '+ Add Applicant' = green outline button that adds a co-applicant row. 'Confirm >' = the primary advance button (grey when invalid, green when ready). 'Submit >' = the drawer submit button. 'Download your Unit Details' = the success-page link that opens the Digital Booking Form PDF print dialog. 'Go to Home >' = returns to /home.

7. STATUS FLAGS (WF §7 / FS 1.5): isKycSubmitted (form data submitted), eVerificationCompleted (OTP e-verification done), isKycPdfSubmitted (KYC PDF generated + stored in Azure), selfKycSubmitted (buyer self-submitted), bookingFormActivitySubmitted / bookingActivitySubmitted (LSQ syncs), mavisBookingFinalUpdated (Mavis marked Final). These are backend flags — UI exposes only the 'KYC Completed' process status; flag-level assertions are API/DB-layer and [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED].

8. BUSINESS RULES: all 4 documents (photograph, PAN card, Aadhaar front, Aadhaar back) are mandatory PER applicant — partial uploads are rejected (BRD §4 rule 9, WF §4, FS 1.6 rule 2). Max 4 applicants total = 1 primary + 3 co-applicants; at the limit the '+ Add Applicant' button disappears and 'Max. 4 Applicants allowed' is shown (BRD §4 rule 10, WF §5). PAN format = ABCDE1234F (5 alpha + 4 numeric + 1 alpha); Aadhaar = 12 digits; co-applicant relationship must be a blood relative (parents/spouse/siblings/children); primary relationship is locked to 'Self'.

9. DOWNSTREAM (silent-by-design where stated): on submission documents upload to Azure Blob Storage, sync to LeadSquared, the Mavis booking is marked Final, the milestone PAYMENT SCHEDULE is generated, the KYC PDF is generated via Puppeteer, and the buyer receives a WhatsApp confirmation (Kaleyra). LSQ/Mavis failures are NON-BLOCKING — the KYC confirmation is still shown and a cron retries every 10 minutes (WF §6, §8 rule 6). Per CLAUDE.md rule 6, a missing toast/modal is NOT a bug until the backend side-effect is verified.

10. SCOPE EXCLUSIONS: LeadSquared (LSQ) is excluded from direct test calls — assert only the downstream portal effect / the documented sync flag, never call LSQ. Strapi is excluded — KYC field labels/validation are Strapi-configurable (WF §8 rule 7) so exact label/validation strings may drift; treat label-exactness cases as [VERIFY WITH DEV] against the live render. Mavis/Easebuzz/Razorpay/Azure/Epinet/Kaleyra are integrations — assert the documented effect only.

11. DOC_DRIFT-001 — STEP COUNT: FS 1.4 documents a 5-STEP process with a Step-4 E-VERIFICATION (OTP) screen, and BRD §6 / WF §6 step 8 also reference an OTP e-verification. The FULL visual-memory capture (buyer/kyc INDEX.md, 2026-06-04) shows only 4 ON-SCREEN steps — Step 1 Add Applicants → Step 2 Add Applicant drawer → Step 3 Summary/Confirm (T&C) → Step 4 KYC Submitted Successfully — with NO OTP e-verification screen captured between Summary and Success. Live UI wins for STEPS/EXPECTED. KYC e-verification (OTP) TCs are retained (BRD/WF/FS require the flag eVerificationCompleted) but are tagged [VERIFY WITH DEV] for whether an OTP screen renders for the BUYER self-KYC path (it may apply only to the SM physical-allocation path). [To verify] confirm whether buyer self-KYC shows an OTP e-verification step on the live UI.

12. DOC_DRIFT-002 — DRAWER FIELDS: FS 1.4 Step-1 field list and BRD/WF reference Date of Birth, Occupation and Income Details as required applicant fields. The captured Add Applicant drawer (buyer/kyc INDEX.md Step 2) shows ONLY: First Name*, Last Name*, Mobile Number*, Email Address*, Full Current Address*, Pincode*, Relationship*, PAN Number*, Aadhaar Number*, and the four document uploads — NO DOB / Occupation / Income fields are visible. [To verify] confirm whether DOB/Occupation/Income exist on the live buyer drawer or are SM/CP-only or removed.

tcs.expected: The endpoint returns HTTP 207 (Multi-Status) yet the body reports success:true — a known inconsistency where the partial failure is masked as success. Document as a BUG; the body should reflect the partial failure. [VERIFY WITH DEV] confirm the behaviour on the current build.

tcs.scenario: To verify /upload-kyc-form is rejected before KYC submit
tcs.description: Verify that the /upload-kyc-form endpoint rejects a request issued before KYC has been submitted.
tcs.precond: A WINNER unit with KYC not yet submitted. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] API access + a pre-submit unit.
tcs.steps:
1. Call /upload-kyc-form for a unit before KYC submit.
2. Read the response.
tcs.expected: The endpoint rejects the request because KYC has not been submitted yet (precondition order enforced). [VERIFY WITH DEV] confirm the exact status/message.

tcs.scenario: To verify parking selection requires master_config.park_enabled = true (API)
tcs.description: Verify that a parking selection during KYC is allowed only when the parking config flag is enabled.
tcs.precond: Knowledge of the master_config.park_enabled state. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] API access + config visibility.
tcs.steps:
1. With park_enabled=false, attempt a parking selection during the KYC flow.
2. With park_enabled=true, attempt the same.
tcs.expected: Parking selection is rejected when master_config.park_enabled=false and allowed when true. [VERIFY WITH DEV] confirm whether parking is part of the buyer KYC flow on UAT (no parking control was captured in the buyer KYC drawer).

tcs.scenario: To verify submit-KYC without a token is rejected (API)
tcs.description: Verify that calling submit-KYC with no/invalid bearer token is rejected with 401.
tcs.precond: API access without a valid token. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] API access.
tcs.steps:
1. Call submit-KYC with no Authorization header.
2. Call submit-KYC with a tampered/expired token.
3. Read the responses.
tcs.expected: Both calls are rejected with 401 Unauthorized; no KYC is submitted and no PII is returned (role/auth dimension). [VERIFY WITH DEV] confirm the exact 401 body.

tcs.scenario: To verify a non-WINNER unit is rejected at submit-KYC (API)
tcs.description: Verify that submit-KYC for a unit that has not reached WINNER status is rejected server-side.
tcs.precond: A non-WINNER unit for the authenticated buyer. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] API access + a non-WINNER unit.
tcs.steps:
1. Call submit-KYC for a non-WINNER unit owned by the buyer.
2. Read the response.
tcs.expected: The backend rejects the request because the WINNER prerequisite is not met (WF §3, BRD §4 rule 8). [VERIFY WITH DEV] confirm the exact status/message.

tcs.scenario: To verify injection payloads at the KYC API are safely handled
tcs.description: Verify that SQLi/XSS payloads sent to KYC fields at the API are safely rejected with no leakage.
tcs.precond: API access to add-applicant / submit-KYC. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] API access + a disposable unit.
tcs.steps:
1. Call add-applicant with a SQLi payload in a text field (e.g. name).
2. Call with an XSS payload (e.g. <script>).
3. Read the responses.
tcs.expected: The payloads are safely handled (parameterised queries / sanitisation) — no SQL error, no script reflection, the request fails validation cleanly. [VERIFY WITH DEV] confirm backend sanitisation on KYC fields.

tcs.scenario: To verify a browser refresh mid-flow preserves entered data
tcs.description: Verify that refreshing the page mid-KYC-flow preserves the entered applicant data.
tcs.precond: On KYC Step 1/2 with data entered (not yet submitted). [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a WINNER booking.
tcs.steps:
1. Enter applicant data on Step 1/2 (do not submit).
2. Refresh the browser (F5).
3. Observe the data.
tcs.expected: [VERIFY WITH DEV] state-preservation across refresh is not documented in BRD/FRD/FS and not captured. [To verify] confirm whether refreshing mid-flow preserves the entered data or resets to the unitId landing state.

tcs.scenario: To verify Back from Step 2 returns to Step 1 with data intact
tcs.description: Verify that navigating back from the drawer/Step 2 to Step 1 preserves applicants already entered.
tcs.precond: On KYC Step 2 (drawer) after entering data. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a WINNER booking.
tcs.steps:
1. Enter data in the drawer / advance toward Step 2.
2. Use Back/Cancel to return to Step 1.
3. Observe the applicants list.
tcs.expected: Returning to Step 1 keeps already-submitted applicants in the table; un-submitted drawer edits follow the Cancel behaviour (see TC_KYC_FUNC_002). [VERIFY WITH DEV] confirm whether browser Back (vs the in-app Cancel/Back) preserves data identically.

tcs.scenario: To verify the KYC flow on a mobile viewport
tcs.description: Verify that the KYC flow renders without overflow on a small mobile viewport (portal is mobile-first).
tcs.precond: Browser set to a 375x667 mobile viewport on a WINNER unit. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a WINNER booking.
tcs.steps:
1. Set the viewport to 375x667.
2. Open /kyc?unitId= via Complete KYC.
3. Scroll through Step 1, the drawer and the Summary.
tcs.expected: All KYC steps render within the viewport with no horizontal overflow and the buttons stay tappable (BRD §1 'mobile-first'). [VERIFY WITH DEV] no mobile-viewport baseline screenshot is held; confirm against the live render.

tcs.scenario: To verify a tampered unitId base64 is handled safely
tcs.description: Verify that a malformed/tampered unitId base64 param does not expose another unit or crash the page.
tcs.precond: Logged in as a buyer. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a valid buyer session.
tcs.steps:
1. Open /kyc?unitId= with a malformed base64 value.
2. Open /kyc?unitId= with another buyer's encoded unit id.
3. Observe the result.
tcs.expected: A malformed unitId shows the EMPTY_GATE / a safe error (no crash); another buyer's unitId does not expose that unit's KYC form (ownership isolation). [VERIFY WITH DEV] confirm the server rejects a non-owned/decoded unitId.

tcs.scenario: To verify a network failure during submit-KYC shows a retry option
tcs.description: Verify that a network failure while submitting KYC surfaces an error with a retry path and does not corrupt state.
tcs.precond: On the Summary step about to Confirm, with the ability to simulate a network failure. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a disposable WINNER booking + authorisation.
tcs.steps:
1. Tick T&C and click 'Confirm >'.
2. Force the submit request to fail (block in DevTools).
3. Observe the UI.
tcs.testData: [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] disposable WINNER booking; forced network failure
tcs.expected: A user-facing error is shown and the buyer can retry the submission without losing entered data; KYC is not marked submitted on a failed call. [VERIFY WITH DEV] confirm the exact error text and retry affordance. [Mutation — requires authorisation.]

tcs.scenario: To verify the EMPTY_GATE on direct /kyc with no unitId
tcs.description: Verify that hitting /kyc with no unitId while authenticated shows the documented empty gate (no error, no form).
tcs.precond: Logged in as a buyer. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a valid buyer session.
tcs.steps:
1. Navigate directly to https://uat.xrportal.in/kyc (no unitId).
2. Observe the content area.
tcs.expected: An EMPTY_GATE renders — no headings, no form and no applicants table — without an error page; the flow is reachable only via Complete KYC with ?unitId= (visual-memory re-verify 2026-06-06).

tcs.scenario: To verify the Confirm > button gating on Step 1
tcs.description: Verify the context-sensitive 'Confirm >' button on Step 1 is grey until all applicants are valid (documents + details complete) and turns green when ready.
tcs.precond: On KYC Step 1. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a WINNER booking.
tcs.steps:
1. On Step 1 with an incomplete applicant, look at 'Confirm >'.
2. Complete/verify the applicant's details and documents.
3. Look at 'Confirm >' again.
tcs.expected: 'Confirm >' is grey/disabled while any applicant is incomplete and turns green/enabled only when validation is complete (context-sensitive control; visual-memory Step 1 'grey when validation incomplete, green when ready'). [VERIFY WITH DEV] confirm the exact completeness criteria that flip the button.

tcs.scenario: To verify the Verify Details routing differs by applicant state
tcs.description: Verify that the 'Verify Details' link routes to a pre-filled drawer for the primary applicant and to an empty drawer for a freshly added co-applicant.
tcs.precond: On KYC Step 1 with a primary + a freshly added co-applicant. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a WINNER booking + disposable co-applicant.
tcs.steps:
1. Click 'Verify Details' on the primary row.
2. Close, then click 'Verify Details' on the new co-applicant row.
3. Compare the drawer contents.
tcs.expected: The primary drawer is pre-filled from registration; the new co-applicant drawer opens empty for fresh entry (context-sensitive control by applicant state; visual-memory Step 1/Step 2).

tcs.scenario: To verify Pincode accepts only a valid 6-digit code
tcs.description: Verify the Pincode field boundary — it accepts only a valid Indian 6-digit pincode.
tcs.precond: The Add Applicant drawer is open. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a WINNER booking.
tcs.steps:
1. Enter a 5-digit pincode and try to submit.
2. Enter a 7-digit pincode.
3. Enter a valid 6-digit pincode (e.g. 400060).
tcs.expected: Non-6-digit pincodes are rejected/blocked and only a 6-digit value is accepted (boundary; visual-memory drawer Pincode* field; test-account pincode 400060). [VERIFY WITH DEV] confirm the exact pincode validation rule.

tcs.scenario: To verify the PAN field uppercases / normalises input
tcs.description: Verify how the PAN Number field handles lowercase input and surrounding spaces.
tcs.precond: The Add Applicant drawer is open. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a WINNER booking.
tcs.steps:
1. Type a PAN in lowercase (e.g. 'bajpc4350m').
2. Type a PAN with leading/trailing spaces.
3. Observe the field value.
tcs.expected: [VERIFY WITH DEV] PAN normalisation (uppercasing/trimming) is not documented. [To verify] confirm whether the field uppercases lowercase input and trims spaces, and whether a lowercase PAN passes the ABCDE1234F format check (the captured test value is uppercase 'BAJPC4350M').

tcs.scenario: To verify a duplicate document upload across slots
tcs.description: Verify behaviour when the same file is uploaded to two different document slots for one applicant.
tcs.precond: The Add Applicant drawer is open. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a WINNER booking + a disposable file + authorisation.
tcs.steps:
1. Upload the same disposable file to the PAN slot and the photograph slot.
2. Observe whether both accept it.
tcs.expected: [VERIFY WITH DEV] cross-slot duplicate-file handling is not documented. [To verify] confirm whether the same file can occupy two slots or is flagged. [Mutation/upload — requires authorisation.]

tcs.scenario: To verify no buyer notification is sent for capture-only steps (silent UX)
tcs.description: Verify the silent-by-design behaviour that opening the drawer / viewing the Summary dispatches NO SMS/WhatsApp/email.
tcs.precond: On Step 1/2/3 performing capture-only actions. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a WINNER booking + notification-log visibility.
tcs.steps:
1. Open the Add Applicant drawer and the Summary (no submit).
2. Check outbound notification logs.
tcs.expected: No SMS/WhatsApp/email is dispatched for capture-only navigation — notifications occur only at KYC submission (WhatsApp confirmation via Kaleyra, WF §6 step 9). Silence here is by design, not a bug (CLAUDE.md rule 6). [VERIFY WITH DEV] confirm no side-channel notification on drawer/summary view.

tcs.scenario: To verify the UI document-size cap vs the API no-cap split
tcs.description: Verify the documented UI-vs-backend split — the UI rejects an oversized document but the upload-kyc-form API does not enforce a size limit.
tcs.precond: Both UI and API access available. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a WINNER booking + API access + an oversized file.
tcs.steps:
1. In the UI drawer, attempt to upload an oversized document (expect rejection — see BYR_KYC_021).
2. Via the API, post the same oversized file to /upload-kyc-form (see BYR_KYC_045).
3. Compare the outcomes.
tcs.expected: The UI rejects the oversized file but the API accepts it (no enforced size cap) — a UI/backend validation split and security gap. Document the bypass (cross-reference BYR_KYC_021 / BYR_KYC_045). [VERIFY WITH DEV] confirm both halves on the current build.

tcs.scenario: To verify the No.-of-Applicants count is consistent across Summary and Success
tcs.description: Verify that the applicant count shown on the Summary matches the count on the KYC success screen.
tcs.precond: A disposable booking taken through to success with N applicants. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a disposable submission + authorisation.
tcs.steps:
1. Note the Applicant Details count on the Summary.
2. Complete submission.
3. Read 'No. of Applicants' on the success screen.
tcs.expected: The 'No. of Applicants' on the success screen equals the Applicant Details count from the Summary (integration/consistency; visual-memory Step 3 + Step 4). [Mutation — requires authorisation.]

tcs.scenario: To verify pagination/listing boundaries are N/A for KYC applicants
tcs.description: Document that KYC has no paginated list/table beyond the max-4 applicants table, so pagination boundaries are not applicable.
tcs.precond: On KYC Step 1. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] a WINNER booking.
tcs.steps:
1. Review the applicants table on Step 1.
2. Confirm there is no pagination control.
tcs.expected: N/A — the only KYC table is the applicants table capped at 4 rows (BYR_KYC_014); there is no pagination, page-size or last-partial-page control to test. Boundary coverage for KYC is the max-4 limit, file type/size and field-length cases (justified N/A for the pagination dimension).

subModules.name: Cross-Portal KYC (CP / SM assist) — documented scope

tcs.scenario: To verify CP-assisted KYC processes the same as buyer self-KYC
tcs.description: Verify the documented cross-portal rule that a Channel Partner can complete KYC on the buyer's behalf and it processes identically.
tcs.precond: A CP is logged into the CP Portal with a WINNER customer. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] CP access + a WINNER customer (CP-portal scope).
tcs.steps:
1. In the CP Portal, navigate to KYC for the WINNER customer.
2. Fill applicant details, add co-applicants if needed, upload all 4 documents per applicant.
3. Submit.
tcs.expected: The CP completes the same KYC flow and the system processes it identically to buyer self-submission (WF §2, §How-to CP). [VERIFY WITH DEV] this is the CP-portal surface — confirm against the CP visual-memory; out of buyer-portal UI scope but documented here for traceability.

tcs.scenario: To verify SM physical-allocation KYC mirrors the buyer flow
tcs.description: Verify the documented cross-portal rule that the SM completes KYC at a physical allocation event using the same steps.
tcs.precond: An SM at a physical allocation event with a paid customer. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] SM access + a paid customer (SM-portal scope).
tcs.steps:
1. In the SM Portal, the KYC screen opens at /sales-manager/physical-allocation/kyc.
2. Complete the pre-filled primary applicant, upload all 4 documents, add co-applicants if needed.
3. Submit.
tcs.expected: The SM completes the same KYC flow with documents captured on site and the booking is completed identically (WF §2, §How-to SM; note 11 — the OTP e-verification step may apply specifically to this SM path). [VERIFY WITH DEV] this is the SM-portal surface — confirm against SM visual-memory; documented here for traceability.
